record.description: MARK-58 vendor-custody mirror for the MARK-46 reference-pack pools. The upstream pool roots and upstream license are copied here with provenance intact; support-only surfaces remain mirrored but are excluded from the candidate count where they are not candidate entries.

inventory.uncertainty: The four pools are preserved as vendor-custody mirrors, but the source record keeps support-only surfaces out of the candidate total so the reconciliation reflects actual candidate entries rather than helper files.

pools.name: saas-packs
pools.reason: Broad SaaS catalog with nested support scaffolding and many individually useful packs; mirrored as permissive vendor custody with support-only subpaths excluded from candidate totals.

pools.name: business-tools
pools.reason: Mixed business and productivity methodology packs are mirrored under MIT custody; `general-legal-assistant` is kept in the mirror but excluded from the candidate total as a support/helper surface.

pools.name: community
pools.reason: Community bundles are heterogeneous with mixed MIT and Apache-2.0 licensing, so the pack roots are mirrored; the `.gitkeep` support file stays out of the candidate total.

pools.name: crypto
pools.reason: Crypto packs depend on live market-data and trading workflows, but the upstream source is MIT and the pack roots are mirrored as vendor custody rather than activated marketplace content.
